aboutGame.title: What is Among the Trolls?
paragraphs: Among the Trolls is a first-person survival adventure set in the misty Finnish wilderness. You play as a grandchild returning to a remote family cabin, only to find your grandfather missing and a forest full of foraging, building, and folklore that watches you from between the pines. Developer Avantgarden SRL builds the world around Finnish mythology rather than zombies or raiders, so the threats you meet are territorial trolls, forest spirits, and weather that turns on you without warning.

Progress runs through crafting and preparation: gather wood, stone, and plant fiber, raise a shelter before dark, and balance two folklore systems, Vaki (magic) and Lykky (luck), that shape what you can attempt and how risky each trip becomes. The game shipped at full launch on October 14, 2026 for Windows PC on Steam as a single-player campaign at $19.99, with 14 Steam achievements, full English audio, and subtitles across 11 interface languages. Our Among the Trolls wiki gathers the systems, the mythology, and the practical survival routes in one place.

modules.name: Among the Trolls Beginner Guide
modules.description: New to Among the Trolls? This is the order of operations for your first in-game day: scout the cabin clearing, bank loose materials, craft a cutting tool and fire, and get a roof and a full stomach before nightfall.

highlights.detail: Scout the area around the cabin and note landmarks: water, rock outcrops, and deadfall
Collect loose materials: sticks, stones, and plant fiber from the forest floor
Craft a cutting tool first, then a fire-starting kit for warmth and cooking
Raise a small shelter with a fire pit and one storage box before dark

modules.name: Among the Trolls Crafting Guide
modules.description: Crafting is the spine of Among the Trolls. Learn what each material family is for, how the crafting loop is staged, and how gathered wood, stone, fiber, and animal materials become tools, shelter, storage, and travel gear.

highlights.label: Tools
highlights.detail: A basic blade unlocks efficient wood gathering and everything that follows it

highlights.label: Fire
highlights.detail: Torches and fire pits deliver warmth, cooking, light, and safety at night

highlights.label: Shelter
highlights.detail: Rain cover, bedding, and a fire pit turn a camp into a survivable base

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: Containers free inventory space so gathering trips stop ending early

highlights.label: Travel
highlights.detail: Portable light and upgraded weapons extend your safe exploration radius

highlights.label: Ritual
highlights.detail: Prepared light and ritual-appropriate gear answer threats a spear cannot

modules.name: Among the Trolls Survival Tips
modules.description: The Among the Trolls wilderness punishes rushing. Manage health, stamina, hunger, thirst, and warmth, build a camp that funnels threats, and learn how trolls, spirits, and predatory wildlife behave before you pick a fight.

highlights.label: Warmth
highlights.detail: Shelter and fire outrank weapons on your upgrade list for the first week

highlights.label: Water
highlights.detail: Build near a lake or stream so thirst never forces a long trek

highlights.label: Food
highlights.detail: Keep one cooked meal in reserve and top up supplies before every trip

highlights.label: Stamina
highlights.detail: Walk between tasks and spend sprinting only to escape a threat

highlights.label: Night
highlights.detail: Plan travel so you are back behind your perimeter before dark

highlights.label: Retreat
highlights.detail: Retreat early, because healing costs more resources than avoiding a fight

modules.name: Among the Trolls Vaki and Lykky Guide
modules.description: Vaki and Lykky are the two folklore forces you balance on every run. Vaki is the animistic power held by people, places, and objects; Lykky is personal fortune and your guardian spirit. Together they decide what you can attempt and when to stop pushing.

highlights.label: Vaki
highlights.detail: A finite animistic force you spend and must replenish or respect

highlights.label: Lykky
highlights.detail: Personal fortune and a guardian spirit that swing risky outcomes

highlights.label: Haltija
highlights.detail: Guardian spirits of a place or household: greet the land before you strip it

highlights.label: Luonto
highlights.detail: Inner nature and born strength that shape what your character endures

modules.name: Among the Trolls Story and Quest Guide
modules.description: Follow the campaign that gives Among the Trolls its shape. Trace Anna's search for her missing grandfather through the Finnish archipelago, use craftable bridges to open new routes, and keep the story milestones in order without skipping the exploration that unlocks them.

highlights.detail: Arrive at your grandfather's remote cabin and search it for the first clues
Follow the trail into the Finnish archipelago and map the landmarks you pass
Build craftable bridges to open routes across water and reach new story areas
Track Anna's family mystery through each quest beat without skipping side exploration

modules.name: Among the Trolls Creatures and Finnish Mythology
modules.description: Among the Trolls draws its cast from the Kalevala and Finnish folk belief. Compare the Peikko trolls, Hiisi groves, Nakki water spirits, and Menninkainen, and see how each one changes the way you move through the forest.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Peikko - the namesake trolls: large, territorial, and best avoided until you have gear

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Hiisi groves and Nakki water spirits - uncanny places that punish careless routes

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Menninkainen - elusive forest folk you only spot if you slow down and watch

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Haltija and Tapio - guardian figures that reward respect over aggression

modules.name: Among the Trolls PC Requirements
modules.description: Check the official minimum and recommended Among the Trolls PC specifications before you buy. Compare operating system, processor, graphics card, memory, DirectX, and storage, alongside Steam Deck status, controller support, and launch pricing.

highlights.label: OS
highlights.detail: Windows 10 Home 64-bit on both the minimum and recommended builds

highlights.label: CPU
highlights.detail: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600 minimum; i7-10700K or Ryzen 7 4800H recommended

highlights.label: RAM
highlights.detail: 16 GB minimum, 32 GB recommended for smoother frame pacing in dense forest

highlights.label: GPU
highlights.detail: GTX 1070 or RX 5600XT minimum; RTX 2080 Ti or RX 7700XT recommended

highlights.label: Storage
highlights.detail: 30 GB available space, with an SSD strongly preferred at both tiers

modules.name: Among the Trolls Tips and Tricks
modules.description: The habits that separate a clean run from a long walk back to your body. Learn reliable gathering routes, when to reinvest materials, why defense beats decoration, and how to plan travel around the day and night cycle.

highlights.label: Routes
highlights.detail: Learn two or three reliable gathering routes and cycle them instead of wandering

highlights.label: Stock
highlights.detail: Convert surplus materials into tools and upgrades as soon as a recipe unlocks

highlights.label: Defense
highlights.detail: Build the perimeter before the decorations; an unfinished longhouse protects nothing

highlights.label: Daylight
highlights.detail: Plan every trip so you are back inside before the light goes

highlights.label: Light
highlights.detail: Carry a torch and spare fuel, because night visibility drops sharply

highlights.label: Patience
highlights.detail: Information beats aggression: watch a patrol before you commit

faq.title: Among the Trolls FAQ
faq.description: Straight answers to the questions new players ask most about Among the Trolls.

items.question: What is Among the Trolls?
items.answer: Among the Trolls is a first-person survival adventure from developer Avantgarden SRL, published by 505 Pulse and 505 Games. You return to a remote Finnish cabin to find your grandfather missing, then survive the wilderness around it by gathering, crafting, building shelter, and reading the folklore-driven threats that share the forest.

items.question: Is Among the Trolls multiplayer?
items.answer: No. Among the Trolls is single-player only at launch, with no online co-op, local split-screen, or Remote Play Together support. Anna's story is written for one player, while Steam Cloud saves, Family Sharing, and 14 Steam achievements are all supported.

items.question: How much does Among the Trolls cost?
items.answer: Among the Trolls launched at $19.99, with a 15% introductory discount that brought it to $16.99 through October 28. The separate Among the Trolls Soundtrack is $3.99, and there is no deluxe edition or season pass.

items.question: What are the Among the Trolls system requirements?
items.answer: Minimum is Windows 10 Home 64-bit, an Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600, 16 GB RAM, a GTX 1070 or RX 5600XT, DirectX 12, and 30 GB of storage. Recommended raises that to an i7-10700K or Ryzen 7 4800H, 32 GB RAM, and an RTX 2080 Ti or RX 7700XT. An SSD is preferred at both tiers.

items.question: Which platforms can run Among the Trolls?
items.answer: Among the Trolls launched on Windows PC through Steam. There are no PlayStation, Xbox, or Switch store pages at launch, macOS and Linux are not listed, and Valve rates Steam Deck compatibility as unknown. Xbox controllers are supported.

items.question: What are Vaki and Lykky in Among the Trolls?
items.answer: Vaki is the animistic power held by people, places, and objects, and it works as a resource you spend and must respect. Lykky is personal fortune and your guardian spirit, a volatile modifier on risky outcomes. Together they decide whether a plan survives contact with the forest.

items.question: Is there a tutorial in Among the Trolls?
items.answer: Not in the hand-holding sense. The area around the starting cabin works as a soft tutorial because it is stocked with the basic materials you need, so spend your first half hour there learning the crafting and survival menus before heading deeper into the forest.
